test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

An exact copy of handwriting, printing
solution: The correct answer is: **Facsimile** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Facsimile **means an exact copy or replica of something, especially of written or printed material. (किसी चीज़ की सटीक प्रतिलिपि या प्रतिकृति, विशेषकर लिखित या मुद्रित सामग्री की) • Grammatically, it is a noun and can be used in a sentence like "*He showed me a facsimile of the original document*". • It is derived from the Latin word '**fac simile**' which means '**make similar**'. • In the given context, **facsimile **is the most appropriate word to substitute the group of words '**an exact copy of handwriting, printing**'. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Platitude **means a remark or statement that is overused and has no originality. (ऐसी टिप्पणी या कथन जिसका अत्यधिक उपयोग किया गया हो और जिसमें कोई मौलिकता न हो) • **Maiden **means a young unmarried woman. (एक युवा अविवाहित महिला) • **Potable **means fit for drinking. (पीने के लिए उपयुक्त) 1b0:T1561, The correct answer is **"in".**
